provenance: Tibet 10 (world 2, level 9) normal exit 99,15, control-only from spawn on the exact S700 core (logic and paint each frame). Start values: weaponTier 8 (ice hammer from the Tibet 6 chest; Tibet 7+ may start with it; tier 8 also includes the hook), maxHealth 4 (no armor), lives 12 (campaign value used by the other Tibet routes), 0 diamonds. No damage taken at the end (health 4), no deaths, no resets. Route: (1) riddle 0: step on 9,14 (gate 8,14 closes), break the brick cage 2-4x9-11 with the ice hammer to free the ice creature, lure it along row 7 and freeze it beside the hero above each shooter column so the ice block falls onto the shooter (16,12, 19,10, 22,8; the fourth block rests on 24,6), thawing it with the hammer between kills; gate 28,4 opens, checkpoint 29,4. (2) Ceiling traps 32-37 fall behind the hero; statue beam 41,6 crossed by stepping into it and breaking the ice mid-fall with alternating keys (40-frame post-thaw invulnerability) up to 41,5; along row 5, through the grass 50-53,6 so the statues 50,4-5 and 52,4-5 drop one row and the row-4 beams vanish; 53,4 -> 51,4 -> 51,2; riddle-1 trigger 54,2 (one-way gates 53,2 and 77,2 close); checkpoint 55,2. (3) Plate 76,3: cut grass 58,5 so the rope of weight 58,8 reaches 58,2; drop weight 56,1 (cut grass 56,2) and hook it into that rope; hook it along row 3 (60, 62, 64 then re-hooked to 66 before it rolls off stone 64,4, 68, 70,4, 71,5); cut grass 71,6/71,7 so it rests on the column-71 stones; cut grass 71,13 and 71,11 from below so the rope of weight 71,15 lifts the column (weight on top at 71,2); hook it to the pillar top 73,2 and from 76,2 into the shaft 75 (rope column 75 up to 75,2); hook the next lifted stone to 73,2 and into 75,2 (held by the rope) and push it off onto plate 76,3 (gate 77,2); checkpoint 78,2. (4) Plate 97,4: freeze the three channel turtles (ice blocks drop to 85/87/89,11), drop comb stones 84,86,88 into the channels so the floor 84-89,11 is full, hook weight 83,5 to 88,5; hook weight 81,3 west so it falls to 80,9, hook it over the floor along rows 9-10 to 90,10 and push it to 92,10 (rope column 92 up to 92,2); feed stone 90,5 and the weight from 83,5 (now at 88,5) through that elevator (hook from 93,5), hook each from 95,2 onto pillar 94,3 and from 97,3 into the 95-96 pocket (stone 96,5, weight 96,4 kept from rolling by standing at 95,4) and push the weight onto plate 97,4 (gate 98,3); checkpoint 99,3. (5) Exit: from checkpoint 99,3 via 99,4, 100,4, 100,5 and 101,5 down the east shaft (column 101 to 101,9, column 102 to 102,13); west via 101,13 through the grass 100,13 and 99,13 (the column-100 stones drop into 100,13 behind the hero); at 99,13 the hammer cuts grass 98,13 (t=5409), the stone from 98,12 drops into it (t=5413, the one from 98,11 drops to 98,12) and is pushed west twice, to 96,13, as the hero steps to 98,13 (t=5428) and 97,13 (t=5432; the column-99 stones drop into 99,13 behind him); then up into the grass 97,12 (t=5436, while the stone in 98,12 falls on into 98,13) -> 98,12 -> 98,11 -> 98,10 -> 98,9, row 9 west to 94,9, column 94 down to 94,15, east along row 15 through the magic lock 98,15 to exit 99,15 (t=5528), then the automatic exit walk to 110,15. The 99-diamond magic lock 98,15 does not block in S700 1.2.0 (its tile is cleared at map load, cGame map scan case 12).
